mapper.select: SELECT place_id FROM p lms_user_id FROM l user_name FROM u course_id FROM c course_name FROM c company_attendance_id FROM ca student_attendance_id FROM sa training_date FROM s training_start_time FROM sa training_end_time FROM sa blank_time FROM sa status FROM sa note FROM sa FROM m_place AS p INNER JOIN t_user_place AS up ON p.place_id = up.place_id AND up.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_lms_user AS l ON up.lms_user_id = l.lms_user_id AND l.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_user AS u ON l.user_id = u.user_id AND u.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN t_course_user AS cu ON l.lms_user_id = cu.lms_user_id AND cu.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_course AS c ON cu.course_id = c.course_id AND c.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} INNER JOIN m_section AS s ON c_course_id = s_course_id AND s.training_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND s.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN t_student_attendance AS sa ON l.lms_user_id = sa.lms_user_id AND s.training_date = sa.training_date AND sa.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} LEFT OUTER JOIN t_company_attendance AS ca ON l.lms_user_id = ca.lms_user_id AND s.training_date = ca.training_date AND ca.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} WHERE (ca.training_date IS NULL OR (ca.training_date IS NOT NULL AND ca.training_start_time = '' AND ca.training_end_time = '' AND ca.status = '1')) AND u.authority = '0001' AND p.place_id = #{placeId} AND p.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} ORDER BY s.training_date, l.lms_user_id
